plain.text: On a Sabbath, a man with a withered hand was in the synagogue. Some people watched to see if Jesus would heal on the Sabbath so they could accuse him. Jesus asked, "Is it right on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" They said nothing. Jesus looked at them with anger, deeply upset by their hard hearts. He told the man to stretch out his hand, and it was healed. Then the Pharisees began plotting with Herod's supporters to kill Jesus.

Huge crowds came from all over the region to see Jesus. So many people pressed in to touch him that he asked for a boat to be ready. He healed many. Whenever evil spirits saw him, they fell down and shouted, "You are the Son of God!" But he ordered them not to tell who he was.

Jesus went up a mountain and called twelve men to be with him. He would send them out to preach and gave them authority to drive out demons. They were Simon (whom he named Peter), James and John (whom he called "Sons of Thunder"), Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed him.

So many people came that Jesus and his disciples could not even eat. His family thought he was out of his mind and came to take charge of him. Religious teachers from Jerusalem said he was driving out demons by the power of the devil. Jesus answered with a picture: a kingdom or a house divided against itself cannot stand. Satan would not fight against himself. Jesus warned that people can be forgiven every sin, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, calling God's work evil, will never be forgiven.

Jesus' mother and brothers arrived and sent someone to call him. Jesus looked at the people sitting around him and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers! Whoever does God's will is my brother and sister and mother."

summary.bigIdea: Jesus brings God's goodness, even when it stirs up opposition, and he gathers a new family around him.
points: Jesus heals on the Sabbath, and his enemies start to plot against him.
He chooses twelve apostles to be with him and to share his work.
Jesus says that those who do God's will are his true family.
summary.reflection: Jesus was grieved by hard hearts. Is there anywhere your heart has become hard?
